meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 模拟多个AI智能体协作开会并进行决策讨论的场景。适用于需要从多个专业角度分析问题、进行辩论和达成共识的场景，如项目决策、技术方案评审、商业策略制定等。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个AI智能体协作开会并做出决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多角度分析问题并达成共识
copy.tagline_en: Simulate multi-agent meetings for collaborative decision-making
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze problems from multiple perspectives and reach consensus

howto.what: 模拟多个不同专业背景的AI智能体开会讨论，可自定义会议主题、目标与角色；按开场、讨论、辩论、共识、决策五阶段推进并实时展示发言，最后输出含结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当用户需要从多个角度分析问题、需要不同领域专业知识碰撞或模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 组织一个技术架构评审会，讨论是否采用微服务架构
say.note: 自动生成多个角色并开会，输出会议记录

say.text: 召开产品定价策略会议，帮我选出合适的定价方案
say.note: 模拟产品、市场、销售、财务等角色讨论并给结论

say.text: 开一个项目风险评估会，识别主要风险
say.note: 按角色模拟讨论，输出风险清单和应对建议

howto.what_en: Simulates multiple AI agents with different backgrounds meeting. Users set topic, goals, and roles. Discussion runs through opening, debate, consensus, and decision stages, shown live, ending with minutes on conclusions, risks, and actions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs multiple perspectives, cross-domain expertise, or a simulated team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Organize a tech architecture review meeting on whether to adopt microservices.
say_en.note: Creates roles, runs the meeting, and outputs minutes.

say_en.text: Hold a product pricing meeting and help me pick a suitable pricing plan.
say_en.note: Simulates product, market, sales, and finance roles.

say_en.text: Run a project risk assessment meeting to identify key risks.
say_en.note: Outputs a risk list and suggested countermeasures.
